rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Managing anger can be really difficult. Take a break when you feel you are getting angry at your children or someone else.

Go somewhere else for 5 minutes to regain control of your emotions. If you have a safe outdoor space, go outside. You can get through this!
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Menguruskan rasa marah memang tidak mudah. Bila anda mula rasa marah kepada anak‑anak atau sesiapa sahaja, cuba berhenti seketika.

Pergilah ke tempat lain selama 5 minit untuk menenangkan diri dan mengawal emosi anda. Jika ada ruang luar yang selamat, keluar sebentar.

Anda pasti mampu melalui saat ini!

text_1_facilitator.eng: Today’s parenting skill is about how you can support your child’s healthy development as they grow and change. ✨

text_2.eng:
Children have different abilities at different stages of their development. 🌱

It is important to know what your child can do at their current stage. ⚽

This way, you can help plan activities that match their abilities and you can have realistic courses for them. ✨

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: All children develop at the same speed as each other.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That is incorrect.

✨ Each child is unique and will develop at their own pace. Some children may develop in some ways faster than others, while some may take more time.

💚 It is important that parents are patient and supportive, recognising that every child has their own individual path of development. 

❗Remember that issues with your child’s development are not always obvious, and your child’s condition is NOT your fault.

🚩 If you have concerns about your child's development, you should consult with a professional to get support and advice.

quiz_2_question.eng: Let’s now think about how children learn by doing. What do you think - True or False: It is OK to let your child continue trying to do something a few times even if they are not doing it correctly.

quiz_2_feedback_1.eng:
✨ That’s correct! 

🚲 Your child wants to learn and we should support them to continue trying, even if they get it wrong.

⭐ Praise them for persisting! your child will feel supported. Effort is more important than being good at something.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
At this age, children love playing and learning through actions. 🚲 

They learn social values through these activities, and will start asking a lot of questions. ✨

2️⃣ Here are two tips to support the healthy development of your child at this age.

section_1_text.eng:
⚽ Play, play, play! Play helps your child develop relationships with other children and understand social rules.
🚲 They may not like to lose, share, or take turns, but play helps them learn how!
🏆 Praise your child when they follow the rules or accept defeat.

section_2_text.eng:
🧸 Sometimes, your child’s emotions may be big and they may express feelings in a bigger way than it seems they need to. That is alright! your child will learn to manage their emotions. 😃😒😔😣
🌱 your child may talk a lot and askmany questions. You can give short but honest answers. 
💡If your child repeats the question or ask more, that’s great! Support their interest to learn and continue to answer.
